## What changed

## Why

## Design review

Complete the relevant items for visual or interactive changes.

- [ ] Reviewed with real content in the surrounding page.
- [ ] Reviewed at narrow mobile and wide desktop sizes.
- [ ] Reviewed in light and dark appearance.
- [ ] Reviewed hover, press, and keyboard focus where interactive.
- [ ] Reviewed reduced motion where animation changed.

## Safety and cleanup

- [ ] Temporary `/lab/` routes and rejected variants are removed.
- [ ] Unused styles, assets, and imports are removed.
- [ ] The pull request contains no unrelated changes.
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes.

## Decision

For a design exploration, name the selected direction and briefly explain why
it was chosen. Write “Not applicable” for other changes.
